GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (6 Jun 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN - 1001)
APO 500
6 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of TSUDA Shingo.
1. TSUDA, Shingo, incarcerated in Sugamo Prison 13 December 1945, was released unconditionally 31 May 1946.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will therefore make the proper notations in its records.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
